investigation.title: Remote Agents: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Agent Provisioning Evals (production-api)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-23T11:25 with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api's POST /api/agents call could not reach the swarm ELB endpoint at /v1/agents. Because the failure occurs before any agent is provisioned, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected, and all contract assertions are unverifiable.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — the AWS ELB target backing http://[REDACTED].elb.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v1/agents — was unreachable from the production-api at the time of the eval run. The production-api returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning", which terminated the POST /api/agents request before any VM could be allocated. Because all three sibling checks share the identical error message and all produced empty evidence objects, the failure is localized to this single shared upstream dependency (the swarm gateway / ELB), not to individual check logic or eval runner code.

investigations.title: model-matrix eval failure: aura-gpt-5-5 returns 502/424 provider_account_unavailable
investigations.summary: The model-matrix eval failed because exactly one of two configured models, aura-gpt-5-5, returned a 502 bad-gateway wrapping a 424 Failed Dependency with error code provider_account_unavailable. The other model, aura-claude-sonnet-4-6, passed cleanly. This is a localized eval failure scoped to the aura-gpt-5-5 model route; no sibling checks failed and no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
investigations.rootCause: The AURA runtime harness successfully reached the API gateway for aura-gpt-5-5 but the upstream model provider was unreachable at the time of the eval run (2026-08-23T11:24:39Z). The gateway returned HTTP 502 containing an inner 424 Failed Dependency with code provider_account_unavailable and the message "AURA is temporarily unable to reach the model provider. This is an issue on our side, not with your account or credits." This caused the per-model result to record ok=false, provider=null, resolvedModel=null, which in turn set allPassed=false and failedModelCount=1, violating the model-matrix contract assertions that require allPassed=true and failedModelCount=0. The failure is localized to the aura-gpt-5-5 provider integration at the POST /api/agents/[REDACTED]/runtime/test endpoint; the eval infrastructure itself, the contract definitions, and the aura-claude-sonnet-4-6 path all functioned correctly.
